hero.subtitle: When you run out of words, we give them to you.
hero.p1: This is not an 'HR guide'. This is a survival tool for you who have been subjected to workplace bullying, exclusion, or inappropriate treatment.
hero.p2: We offer words for difficult situations, tools for documentation, and understanding of what is happening to you. You are not crazy, and you are not alone.

dialog.title: How Safewing Works?
dialog.desc: Safewing is designed to give you clarity and safety in a challenging situation. We do not collect your data in the cloud.
dialog.step1_text: Use tests and lists to understand if it is bullying or conflict.
dialog.step1_sub_text: Uncertainty eats up resources. Naming helps.
dialog.step2_text: Record events with the Log Tool. It creates a timeline and PDF report.
dialog.step3_text: Simulations and profiles help see the situation from outside.
dialog.step3_sub_text: Restore your ability to function and self-esteem.
dialog.step4_text: Use ready-made message templates and tactics to defend your boundaries.
dialog.step4_sub_text: You will not be left alone. We are on your side.

why.title: Why does this exist?
why.text: Workplace bullying is violence that hides behind 'interaction problems' and 'humor'. It destroys a person's self-esteem, health, and career.
list: It is often impossible for the victim to defend themselves alone.
Organizations often protect themselves, not the victim.
rBurden of proof falls on the exhausted.
We want to change the power dynamics.

comparison.title: Is this bullying?
comparison.col1_p1: Bullying is not always shouting. It is often silent: avoiding eye contact, withholding information, forgetting from meetings.
comparison.col1_p2: It is when you feel in your gut that something is wrong, but you are told 'you are just imagining'.
comparison.col2_p1: Occasional rudeness is not bullying. Bullying is repeated and continuous.
comparison.col2_p2: If you are constantly on guard when going to work, it is no longer just about 'chemistry'.
comparison.col2_p3: Explore different forms of bullying and learn to recognize what is happening to you.
comparison.quote: "It is not a fight if only one is being hit."

log.title: Private Log
log.subtitle: Write it down. Immediately.
log.box_text: When you are stressed, your memory fails. The bully relies on that. Do not give them that advantage.

privacy.local: We do not save your data to the cloud. Everything stays on your device.
privacy.pdf: You can download a PDF report anytime. This is your evidence.

importance.title: Why is recording important?
importance.p1: Occupational safety, doctor, and union ask first: 'Do you have examples written down?'
importance.p2: When you have it in black and white, the conversation changes from 'word against word' to fact-based.
list: Documentation restores the sense of control.
Keeping a diary reduces stress symptoms.

power.title: You have the power
power.text: We do not decide for you. We do not urge you to resign, nor force you to fight.
power.quote: "Courage is not the absence of fear. Courage is acting despite fear."
power.text_bold: We give you a map and a compass. You choose the route.

footer_slogan.title: You are not obligated to know yet what this is.
footer_slogan.subtitle: It is enough that you notice it.
footer_slogan.disclaimer_2: NOTHING IS SAVED WITHOUT YOUR PERMISSION.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We look for answers so you don't have to.
faq.a1: No. All data is saved only in your browser's memory (Local Storage). We have no database, and we do not see what you write. If you clear browsing history, data disappears.
faq.q2: Can employer see that I use this?
faq.a2: No. The site works like any website. We recommend using private browsing (Incognito) and a personal device.
faq.a3: No. This is a peer support and informational tool. We do not offer legal services. In serious situations, contact a union or lawyer.
faq.q4: What if the bully is a supervisor?
faq.a4: This is common. Therefore documentation is especially important. The occupational safety organization is the right party to help then.
faq.q5: Can I use the report in court?
faq.a5: Yes. A diary produced by yourself is evidence. A PDF report is a clear way to present the course of events.
faq.a6: No. Safewing is a free tool.
faq.a7: Safewing has been developed in collaboration with victims of workplace bullying, HR professionals, and coders.
